_설명: 『運転手のくせに』 현장음 베드·효과음(ElevenLabs 사운드 생성, 구독 크레딧 — 추가 달러 없음). 고니감독님 「현장감 있게 사운드 넣어줘」. 모두 사람 목소리 없음(제6장 4 — 사람 있는 장면도 이 베드를 대사 아래 낮게).

tests.text: Heavy rain on a city street at night in Tokyo, rain hitting wet asphalt and puddles, distant traffic hiss and tires on wet road. Realistic field recording, no people talking, no voices, no music.

Inside a quiet car at night in heavy rain: rain drumming on the car roof and windshield, a soft engine idle hum, muffled city traffic outside, an occasional slow rubber wiper sweep. Realistic field recording, no people talking, no voices, no music.
Inside a moving car at night in the rain: low steady engine and tire road noise, rain on the roof, muffled passing cars. Realistic field recording, no people talking, no voices, no music.
